description: Teacher: class-level report for a course over consented telemetry: per scene and per concept accuracy (only where a key or a model judge graded), hint reliance (share of answering learners who asked for a hint), calibration gap (rated answers only), completion. Aggregate only, behind a minimum-cohort floor applied to the learners each figure is computed over; never a learner identifier, and a scene, concept or figure with too few contributors is withheld. Learner counts are banded (cohort_band); per-row attempt counts are exact. Each report respects the floor, but two reports taken before and after a learner plays can be compared: treat figures as a live class view, not a release. course_id is the name of the course's top-level folder under the server's lessons root (the folder holding lesson.json; lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', no '/'). It covers the whole data folder the server is configured with, named by data_folder; the folder is server configuration and cannot be chosen from here. Read-only.
name: class_report
